items.title: Recovering Encrypted LLM Reasoning Traces
items.summary: A few days ago, a paper named “Stealing Reasoning Traces from Proprietary LLM APIs” was published. It describes a simple, yet super elegant way to recover encrypted LLM reasoning traces.

items.title: LLM Heist: Hijacking LiteLLM for Traffic Interception, Key Theft, and Tool-Call Injection
items.summary:
LiteLLM is a popular AI gateway. It provides a unified interface to LLMs and simplifies governance. It also has access to the backend LLM provider keys.

All of that makes it a high-value target. Not only for IP and data theft, but also for response modification and tool invocation.
